pack.being_removed: It is being removed right now. Try again in a moment.
pack.configured: WardogClips is set to use this speech model. Choose another one in Settings > Speech-to-text first, then remove this one.
pack.cuda.desc: Turns speech into text on an NVIDIA graphics card, many times faster than on the processor. NVIDIA CUDA libraries (cuBLAS, cuDNN) from NVIDIA's own PyPI packages.
pack.cuda.elsewhere: Not needed: this PC already has it (the CUDA libraries are in the Python environment).
pack.cuda.no_nvidia: Not needed: this PC has no NVIDIA graphics card.
pack.cuda.title: Speech engine for your graphics card
pack.deno.desc: Lets WardogClips read YouTube pages when it downloads stream recordings. The Deno JavaScript runtime for yt-dlp; not needed when Node.js is installed.
pack.deno.node: Not needed: Node.js on this PC already does this job.
pack.deno.on_path: Not needed: Deno is already installed on this PC.
pack.deno.title: YouTube helper
pack.err.checksum: {file} of {repo} failed its check (checksum mismatch), so the download was damaged. Try again.
pack.err.cuda_dlls: The CUDA packages did not contain the cublas64 / cudnn64 DLLs.
pack.err.extract: The yt-dlp update was not extracted completely ({done} of {total} files). Try again.
pack.err.host: WardogClips refused download host {host}: it is not one of the fixed add-on hosts.
pack.err.in_use: The installed add-on {id} is in use ({error}). Restart WardogClips and try again.
pack.err.incomplete: The model download finished, but the model is not complete in the cache.
pack.err.member: The archive held a file outside the add-on folder ({file}), so it was refused.
pack.err.no_checksum: The model listing of {repo} gave no checksum for {file}.
pack.err.no_deno: The Deno download held no deno.exe.
pack.err.no_nvidia: No NVIDIA graphics card was found, so the speech engine for the graphics card would not be used.
pack.err.no_revision: The model listing of {repo} gave no revision.
pack.err.no_source: No download source is known for the model {name}.
pack.err.no_ytdlp: The yt-dlp package held no yt_dlp folder.
pack.err.redirects: The download was redirected too many times.
pack.err.sha256: {file} failed its check (sha256 mismatch), so the download was damaged. Try again.
pack.err.short: The download of {file} stopped at {have} of {size} bytes. Try again to resume it.
pack.installing_elsewhere: Another WardogClips window is installing it right now. Try again when that is done.
pack.locked_elsewhere: Another WardogClips window is installing this add-on right now. Try again when that is done.
pack.locked_files: Some of its files are still in use, so they could not all be deleted. Restart WardogClips and remove it again.
pack.model.large_v3.plain: Most accurate and understands many languages; slow without an NVIDIA graphics card.
pack.model.large_v3.title: Multilingual speech model
pack.model.large_v3_turbo.plain: Nearly as accurate as the multilingual model, faster.
pack.model.large_v3_turbo.title: Fast multilingual speech model
pack.model.medium.plain: Accurate in many languages; meant for an NVIDIA graphics card.
pack.model.medium.title: Accurate speech model, many languages
pack.model.medium_en.plain: Best for English; meant for an NVIDIA graphics card.
pack.model.medium_en.title: Accurate speech model
pack.model.other.title: Speech model {name}
pack.model.small.plain: Good accuracy, quick enough on the processor. Many languages.
pack.model.small.title: Standard speech model, many languages
pack.model.small_en.plain: Good accuracy, quick enough on the processor. English.
pack.model.small_en.title: Standard speech model
pack.model.tiny.plain: Fastest and smallest, makes more mistakes. Many languages.
pack.model.tiny.title: Light speech model, many languages
pack.model.tiny_en.plain: Fastest and smallest, makes more mistakes. English.
pack.model.tiny_en.title: Light speech model
pack.ready: Ready: used from the next transcription.
pack.ready_later: Ready: used from the next transcription (after the one running now).
pack.transcribing: A transcription is using the speech model right now. Remove it when the transcription is done, or stop that job in Jobs.
pack.ytdlp.desc: A newer version of the part that downloads stream recordings, for when a site changes and downloads stop working. The latest yt-dlp from PyPI, used instead of the built-in one.
pack.ytdlp.title: VOD downloader update
pack.ytdlp.unused: The built-in downloader is just as new, so this update is not used.
pack.ytdlp_current: Already up to date: you have the newest downloader (yt-dlp {version}).
packs.installing: It is installing right now. Cancel the install first.

@resolve.gave_up: {why} is the last reason Resolve gave, already a sentence of its own.
resolve.gave_up: gave up after {minutes} min waiting for Resolve ({why})
@resolve.handoff_busy: {what} is an internal step name in English (for example 'markers').
resolve.handoff_busy: another Resolve hand-off is still running ({what} not started)
resolve.handoff_no_answer: Resolve did not answer the hand-off: {error}
resolve.handoff_off: the Resolve hand-off is disabled in Settings > Resolve
resolve.no_export: That export file does not exist anymore.
resolve.no_project: DaVinci Resolve has no project open.
resolve.no_project_hint: no project open in Resolve -- open the project you are cutting first
@resolve.no_such_project: 'project' at the end is the name of the setting in Settings > Resolve.
resolve.no_such_project: Resolve has no project named '{project}' -- open one yourself (or fix Settings > Resolve > project)
@resolve.not_running: Keep the Resolve menu path 'Preferences > System > General > External scripting using = Local' in English: it names DaVinci Resolve's own menus.
resolve.not_running: DaVinci Resolve is not running or refuses scripting -- start DaVinci Resolve, open the project, and check Preferences > System > General > External scripting using = Local
resolve.nothing_left: There was nothing left to send: the events changed while waiting.
resolve.nothing_selected: No events match the selection. Events marked false are never sent; by default only kept events are.
resolve.off: Sending to DaVinci Resolve is turned off (Settings > Resolve).
resolve.open_pm: open a project in Resolve (the Project Manager)
resolve.open_project: No project is open in DaVinci Resolve. Open the project you are editing first.
@resolve.pending: {what} is an internal step name in English (for example 'connect').
resolve.pending: Resolve is not answering ({what} still pending -- is it starting up?)
resolve.starting: Resolve is starting (waiting for its scripting server)
resolve.timeout: Resolve did not answer within {seconds} s (starting up or busy?)
@resolve.wait_timeout: Keep the Resolve menu path 'Preferences > System > General > External scripting using = Local' in English.
resolve.wait_timeout: Resolve did not answer within {minutes} min -- start DaVinci Resolve, open the project, and check Preferences > System > General > External scripting using = Local
search.said_words: Search for at most {max} words of speech.
setup.bad_path: That is not a valid folder path.
setup.network_path: This is a network or device path, so it was not checked. It is still saved as you typed it.
setup.pick_busy: A folder dialog is already open.
setup.pick_local_only: The folder dialog opens on the PC that runs WardogClips, so it works from that PC only.
system.no_quit: This copy of WardogClips cannot be stopped from the page.
system.quit_local_only: Only this computer can stop WardogClips.
update.bad_checksum: The downloaded file did not match its checksum, so it was deleted. Try again later.
update.bad_repo: The update source in Settings > Updates is not a valid owner/name.
update.bad_response: GitHub sent an answer WardogClips could not read. It will try again later.
update.checksum_unreadable: The checksum file of this release could not be read, so nothing was installed.
update.disabled: No update source is set, so WardogClips does not check for updates.
update.download_failed: The download did not finish. Try again to resume it.
update.http_error: GitHub answered with an error. WardogClips will try again later.
update.launch_failed: The installer could not be started. Open the download page and run it yourself.
update.local_only: Updates can be installed from this computer only.
update.need_confirm: This release has no checksum, so WardogClips cannot verify the download. Install it only if you trust where it came from.
update.no_asset: This release has no Windows installer to download. Use the download page instead.
update.not_found: The update page could not be found. The releases may be private, or none are published yet.
update.not_installed: Automatic updating works in the installed version only. Use the download page instead.
update.nothing: There is no update to install.
update.offline: Could not reach GitHub. Check your internet connection.
update.rate_limited: GitHub is limiting update checks right now. WardogClips will try again later.
update.too_big: The installer of this release is larger than expected, so it was not downloaded.

workmode.help.full: Full speed: WardogClips uses all the power it can get, even while you play.
